$description: AssignControl (platform/patterns/AssignControl), library wave 10, lane B: its pattern tokens. The row’s gaps and least heights, the picker’s least width, the Unassigned and Not delegated words, the delegation dates and the delegate dialog’s field gap; the picker, the Persona and the buttons keep their own tokens.

assign-control-gap.$description: AssignControl: gap between who and the actions (space-inline-md).

assign-control-row-gap.$description: AssignControl: gap between lines when the row wraps (space-stack-xs).

assign-control-min-height.$description: AssignControl: the row’s least height (a field’s height) (control-height-standard).

assign-control-assigned-min-height.$description: AssignControl: the row’s least height with an assignee (the Persona’s) (size-32px).

assign-control-picker-min-width.$description: AssignControl: the people picker’s least width (size-240px).

assign-control-form-gap.$description: AssignControl: gap between the delegate dialog’s fields (space-stack-md).
